Yeyiphi indibaniselwano echanekileyo ebonisa ubungakanani be-impulse efunyenwe yinto ngexesha lale $0.4\,\mathrm{s}$ kunye nesantya sento kanye emva kokuba amandla ecime? (Akukho namandla angawo.)
